summary: Intermittent stuck stream (no [DONE]) during peak load
description:
Issue summary: Customer sees intermittent streaming requests that stop emitting tokens and never terminate with [DONE]. They report this clusters around peak traffic windows.

Impact: About 1–3% of streaming requests hang; they must cancel client-side and retry.

Environment: Dedicated in us-east, high QPS, stream=true for most calls.

Investigation hypothesis: backend worker may be wedged while holding a stream open; gateway keeps connection alive due to heartbeat but no new tokens are generated.
comments: Camila Reyes (Support): Customer says they still see 'stuck streams' even after heartbeat rollout. Asking runtime team to investigate potential deadlock.
Hiro Tanaka (Serving Runtime): Pulled traces; looks like a small fraction of requests stop progressing in decode loop when KV cache eviction happens under memory pressure.
Aisha Rahman (SRE): Peak load coincides with higher GPU memory fragmentation. Can we reproduce with perf-canary?
Hiro Tanaka (Serving Runtime): Added debug counters; will run targeted load test and check for scheduler starvation.
Camila Reyes (Support): Customer provided request IDs; attached to ticket.
resolution: Pending. Work in progress to identify serving-runtime stall under KV cache eviction/memory pressure.
